title: Vignette 2026-11-04: a reader wants the rendered view without the comments, but may want the links, sources and citations

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
They are not editing the essay, so they want to just get the read only rendered view. They also don't want to see the comments on which any paragraph was built. But they may want to see the links and references. A quote may want to reveal it's source. A statement may point to a reference document and an external url. 

A paragraph may link to problems, claims and other types. Maybe the viewer wants to be able to browse the background references? See a list of citations?
